signal: Teamworks raised a $235M Series F at a $1B+ valuation and acquired Sportlogiq and PFF's enterprise business to build its AI intelligence platform

email.body1:
Kevin, saw Teamworks raised the $235M Series F and absorbed Sportlogiq and PFF's enterprise business into the AI platform.

Growth and acquisitions like that usually mean more accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp on the combined story, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Teamworks across North America off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kevin, quick follow-up for Teamworks.

After a raise that size plus two acquisitions, the pipeline target usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your North America team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kevin, last bit of proof for Teamworks.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other late-stage software GTM teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kevin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while you integrate Sportlogiq and PFF, no problem at all. Back-to-back acquisitions are their own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your North America motion? I'll tailor it to Teamworks either way.
